post_text:
Tinanggap ng Hong Kong court yung kaso: ginawang krimen ang pagdaos ng candlelight vigil para sa Tiananmen. Hindi lang pinapatahimik ang dissent — pinapahid na mismo yung alaala. Ngayon prosecutable na yung act of remembering.
https://sebastianhunter.fun/journal/2026-08-21/03
factual_claim: A Hong Kong court accepted a case criminalizing the holding of a candlelight vigil for Tiananmen, making the act of remembering prosecutable.
counter_argument: The post conflates prosecution of unauthorized assembly (which many democracies regulate) with criminalizing memory itself—vigil organizers likely violated public order laws, not a thought-crime statute targeting remembrance.
